ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram shows a right triangle with a marked right angle at the intersection of a vertical leg and a horizontal leg. A semicircle is drawn on each side of the triangle. The shaded gray semicircle is the one constructed on the slanted hypotenuse, and the two unshaded crescent-shaped regions lie inside the semicircles on the legs but outside the shaded hypotenuse semicircle. Reasoning: For a right triangle, the classical Hippocrates lunes result says that the total area of the two lunes formed by semicircles on the legs and the semicircle on the hypotenuse equals the area of the original right triangle. The legs are 6 inches and 8 inches, so the triangle area is (1/2)(6)(8) = 24. Therefore, the total area of the two non-shaded crescents is 24.

method.method_draft: Derive the lune area by area cancellation rather than quoting the theorem. From the image, observe that the shaded hypotenuse semicircle is divided by the two legs of the right triangle into the original triangle plus two grey circular segments adjacent to the leg semicircles. The desired white crescents equal the total area of the two leg semicircles minus those two grey segments. From the text, compute the hypotenuse using the 6-8-10 right triangle. The area of a semicircle with diameter d is πd^2/8, so the two leg semicircles have total area π(6^2+8^2)/8=100π/8, exactly the same as the hypotenuse semicircle π(10^2)/8. Since the hypotenuse semicircle consists of the two grey segments plus the triangle, subtracting the grey segments from the leg semicircles leaves exactly the triangle area. Therefore the crescents have area (1/2)(6)(8)=24.

The shaded hypotenuse semicircle consists of the right triangle plus the two gray circular segments. The desired white crescents equal the two leg semicircles minus those same two gray segments. Since the total area of the two leg semicircles equals the area of the hypotenuse semicircle, subtracting the two gray segments leaves exactly the area of the right triangle. The triangle area is (1/2)(6)(8) = 24.
